name: Touri
source:
A shy man who Leaf comes across after telling Alice that she can "hear the sound of water." It turns out the sounds she heard actually came from the pendant Touri carried, which was one of the last things he had left of his wife, Enertia.

[spoiler]He is Lupinus' father who neglected his son because of the grief he experienced after his wife passed away. His absence from his son's life was one of his greatest regrets. He was happy when Lupinus said he wanted them to be the family they never were before, but is still shown to be a little shy when talking to him. [/spoiler]
